source: Frozen results/ledger.json canonical text. Controls and duplicate aliases excluded from indexing.

segmentation.alignment: Only sentence ends coinciding with canonical unit end may split; other ends are ignored and recorded. Split oversized sentence pieces by unit budget.

encoder.pooling: attention-mask weighted mean including active special tokens, raw float32

semantic.rule: Cut when distance>threshold or next piece would exceed budget; budget wins as primary reason; record both predicates. No relevance tuning.

overlap.rule: Step budget-overlap; keep final partial window; stop once a window reaches source end to avoid an entirely redundant tail.

retrieval.indexedText: chunk body only; no title enrichment or reranking
retrieval.statistics: Each partition gets its own BM25 index; changes to document frequency/length are part of the chunking effect.

evaluation.gold: Author-selected source spans with required fact groups; alternatives inside a group are acceptable equivalent sources. Queries/labels fixed before these rankings, already-known synthetic corpus, not blind test.
evaluation.coverage: For each fact,max fraction of required canonical unit IDs covered among its alternatives; query coverage=mean across facts; macro across answerable queries.
evaluation.complete: All fact groups have at least one fully covered alternative in the union of top3 chunks.
evaluation.redundancy: 1-unique retrieved canonical unit IDs / sum returned chunk units; zero with no returned context, report returned count too.
evaluation.negative: No gold facts means coverage/complete null, excluded from answerable aggregate; preserve every ranking, no calibrated abstention threshold.

selection: Retain all outputs,source hashes,negative and unchanged cases. Do not tune threshold,labels or retry selection based on metrics.
limits: Three short synthetic known documents,no production capacity claim,no comparison between different retrievers.
